alerts.title: Acute kidney injury with TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines list TDF as a cause of acute kidney injury. Patient has severe gastroenteritis with dehydration, a strong non-drug cause for AKI (creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, elevated urea, low sodium, low potassium). The clinician is considering stopping TDF permanently. The high urea-to-creatinine ratio and hypovolemic state suggest prerenal AKI from dehydration is the primary cause.

evidence.recommended_action: Manage dehydration first. Re-evaluate TDF after fluid resuscitation and resolution of acute illness.

alerts.title: Missing TDF renal monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring every 12 months for experienced patients on TDF. The patient has been on TDF for 2 years, and the last recorded creatinine before the acute illness was 0.9 mg/dL 375 days ago. This exceeds the 12-month monitoring interval, representing a monitoring gap.

evidence.recommended_action: Ensure regular renal function monitoring every 12 months for patients on TDF, as per guidelines.

alerts.title: Review plan to stop TDF permanently
alerts.message: Guidelines advise evaluating concurrent medications and considering other disease processes when assessing toxicity. The plan to stop TDF permanently is based on an AKI likely caused by severe dehydration from gastroenteritis. Stopping a core ART drug during an acute illness may complicate management and is not indicated unless TDF toxicity is confirmed after resolving the acute insult.

evidence.recommended_action: Defer decision on permanent TDF discontinuation until after treating dehydration and re-assessing renal function.

alerts.title: Continue ART during acute illness
alerts.message: Guidelines for ART-experienced patients reportedly adherent on ART advise continuing ART during admission for acute illness. The patient is virally suppressed and adherent. The clinician's plan does not address ART continuation. Stopping ART could risk virologic failure or resistance.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue the current ART regimen (TDF/3TC/DTG) during treatment for gastroenteritis, as per guidelines.
